cohorts.cohort: Tamil Nadu Directorate of Medical and Rural Health Services (DMS) CEmONC centres, FY2025–26

tn-nhm-51ec-table-1.title: National Health Mission Tamil Nadu 51st Executive Committee Agenda, Part A
tn-nhm-51ec-table-1.notes: Source reports FY2025–26 observed deliveries and the CEmONC beds for all 94 DMS facilities. Bed occupancy rate, staffing proposal, priority, and the publisher's rounded monthly value are excluded. DME medical college hospitals are a separate cohort. Centre and district names retain the report's printed spelling. The 94 site rows sum to the published Table 1 totals of 137,712 deliveries and 6,173 CEmONC beds. The narrative's all-DMS count is a separately published aggregate and is not the source of these targets.

tn-des-population-2022.title: Statistical Hand Book of Tamil Nadu 2022–23, Vital Statistics
tn-des-population-2022.locator: Printed p. 84, Table 2.1, Mid Year Estimated Population 2022 column
tn-des-population-2022.notes: District population estimates as of mid-2022. The district population is a geographic proxy and differs from an individual facility catchment. The 38-row population table sums to the published state total of 76,707,000. Chennai has no centre in the DMS delivery cohort.
